status: Repaired legacy point/spot diffuse and specular attenuation, repeated vertex-buffer Lock/Unlock and D3D7 implicit blending. Original Wine acceptance remains incomplete.
changes: Legacy pre-D3D7 point/spot lighting uses a0+a1*f+a2*f*f, f=1-distance/range, strictly inside positive range. Both diffuse/specular use it before final saturation. Directional and D3D8/9 reciprocal attenuation remain isolated. Shared C and generated WGSL agree; tiny positive ranges retain their actual divisor.

D3D3/7 vertex buffers permit repeated Lock returning the same pointer and excess Unlock succeeds without redundant upload. Merge write intent conservatively; READONLY and NOOVERWRITE survive only if every mapping agrees.

The D3D7 public ProcessVertices entry consumes the observed following scalars for XYZ FVF plus 1..3 blend weights. Build a bounded expanded stream, preserve self-overlap snapshots and indices, zero-fill missing tail scalars instead of reproducing native out-of-allocation reads. Unclipped D3D7 weighted zero-W outputs quiet NaNs; shared modern profiles default to the previous rule.

independentNativeReference.scope: One133second final-source original XP run, zero proxy batches and owners, absolute system32 DLL. Legacy DirectDrawCreate -> QI4/QI3 RGB for diffuse and specular; Ex7 RGB for vertex processing. Both final source/executable hashes match. Saved-output validation was added after observations, no extra boot claimed. An earlier142second specular-only grid has different sample source hashes and is exploratory, not final-source certification.
independentNativeReference.limits: Only the first three vertices of each blend mode have portable in-bounds native expectations. The fourth malformed XYZ vertex can consume allocation-external native bytes and is recorded without portable expected output; proxy tail policy is safely zero-filled. Zero-W behavior is scoped to unclipped weighted D3D7 processing. Repeated mixed READONLY flags were measured; conservative NOOVERWRITE merging and transport failure stubs are local safety tests, not additional native observations.

checks.scope: Actual SDK CPU byte processing and public ProcessVertices with actual shared Windows blend math, every original grid diffuse/specular output checked. Local fixtures cover OOM, bounded overflow, indices, guards, snapshots, repeated locks and failed transport; local stubs are not native/GPU certification. All9 shared scripts and all modern/native GPU pages were rerun after changed shared kernels and FFP source.
checks.corrections: Previously deferred positive-power legacy rows are now checked rather than excluded. The new mutation runner initially had a malformed numeric regex and rejected a genuine runtime fault; fixed to an explicit digit class and reran all13 controls. Vertex controls increased15 to19. Earlier exploratory compilation/mutation attempts remain in build logs; only final successful runs certify this source.
